search_performance.competitor_campaign_note: Competitor search has spent $1,227.77 at $0.59 CPC, versus branded search at $0.21 CPC and 5.68% CTR.

patterns: PAID SCALE IS STILL WORKING, BUT LESS CLEANLY: Total tracked spend is now $13,339.15 YTD ($9,940.56 Meta + $3,398.59 Google), up +77.5% versus the Apr 8 YTD snapshot. Reach and clicks are still climbing hard, but Meta CTR has slipped from 3.28% to 2.95% while CPC nudged from $0.14 to $0.15.

WISCONSIN + PRACTICAL DINNER FRAMING ARE STILL THE BEST PAID HOOKS: 'Straight From Wisconsin' remains the volume leader with 13,622 link clicks at $0.11 CPC and 4.43% CTR. 'Meet Real Dough Pizza Co.' is the sleeper efficiency winner at $0.11 CPC and 4.67% CTR.
GOOGLE BRANDED SEARCH IS THE CLEANEST DEMAND POCKET: branded search is running 5.68% CTR at $0.21 CPC. Competitor search is still the expensive leak at $0.59 CPC and $1,227.77 spent.

INSTAGRAM CONTENT WINNERS ARE HUMAN, EDUCATIONAL, AND FOUNDER-LED: 'Founder Pro Tips' drove 69 engagements on 1,326 reach, and the founder-origin post held a 36.78% engagement rate. The audience still responds best when the brand sounds like real operators, not polished ad copy.

THE CORE BUYER PROFILE IS GETTING OLDER, NOT YOUNGER: on Meta ads, age 65+ now leads raw clicks (14,093) with 4.07% CTR, while 55-64 remains highly efficient at $0.12 CPC. Instagram's biggest audience bucket is still 35-44.

FACEBOOK ORGANIC REPEATS THE SAME PLAYBOOK: helpful ingredient reassurance, easy-dinner framing, and founder/pro-tip reels keep showing up at the top. The best Facebook reel is still a practical prep video, not a glossy product montage.

INSTAGRAM TOP-OF-FUNNEL IS GROWING FASTER THAN DEPTH: followers are up to 623, reach is up to 774,447, but engagement rate has slipped from 3% to 2.58%. The audience is broadening faster than it is bonding.

SOURCE QUALITY REGRESSED ON VIDEO PLATFORMS: this export restored fresh YTD Meta/Google/Facebook/Instagram numbers, but YouTube and TikTok tabs are currently serving Whatagraph sample/demo sheets. That means current cross-platform video conclusions are temporarily blocked by the source, not by lack of analysis effort.
flags: YouTube and TikTok cannot be trusted in this workbook. Their tabs returned sample/demo rows, so any current-period view or top-video call would be false confidence.
Competitor Google search is still the least efficient paid pocket at $0.59 CPC with $1,227.77 already spent YTD.
Meta efficiency is softening under scale: CTR is down 10.1% versus the Apr 8 YTD checkpoint while spend is up 82.1%.
Instagram engagement dilution is real. Reach doubled versus early April, but engagement rate is down 14.0%.
The current export window is YTD through May 12, not a clean weekly cut. It is useful for trend direction and cumulative performance, but not for precise week-over-week content ranking.
recommended_actions: PAID: keep 'Straight From Wisconsin' as the benchmark control, but spin 2-3 new variants around founder credibility, family dinner utility, and ingredient reassurance.
GOOGLE: cut or cap competitor terms first — especially 'screamin sicilian pizza' and the broader competitor campaign — unless Andrew has conversion proof that justifies $1,227.77 in spend.
META TARGETING: bias harder toward 35+ audiences. The older cohorts are carrying both click volume and efficiency; younger demos are not proving incremental value.

ORGANIC IG/FB: keep making founder/pro-tip/process content. 'Founder Pro Tips' and the behind-the-scenes founder/origin posts are the clearest proof that human operator energy beats abstract brand language.

COMMUNITY: add more interaction prompts on Instagram stories and caption endings. The audience is growing, but the falling engagement rate says they need more invitations to participate, not just more impressions.

REPORTING: standardize the direct Whatagraph export path and open a separate follow-up to repair the YouTube/TikTok source connection or tab config. Right now the data-risk is isolated, visible, and fixable.
week_summary: The Friday pull is mostly a win: the workbook is fresh through May 12 and gives a clean YTD read on Meta, Google, Facebook, and Instagram. Paid spend has scaled to $13,339.15 and the brand is still buying real reach, but efficiency is softening as volume rises. The creative answer has not changed much: Wisconsin provenance, founder authority, practical dinner framing, and ingredient honesty keep winning. The big problem this week is source quality on the video platforms — YouTube and TikTok sheets regressed to Whatagraph sample data, so current cross-platform video analysis is temporarily blocked until that export path is fixed.
